{{mu|mi vizykla|We are arrived.}}
The first spoken Lojban [[User:And Rosta|And Rosta]] ever heard:

*[[And Rosta|And]] (answering phone):
**''Hello?''
*[[User:Nick Nicholas|Nick]]:
**'''mi vizykla'''
*And:
**(thinks: ''What the fuck??'')


The story as told by And sooner after it occurred, in a discussion of [[The Glasgow Conversation|the Glasgow Conversation]]:
*When Nick phoned me up when he arrived the first thing he said was '''i vizykla''' and I thought he was speaking Klingon - the last syllable was [[klah]], and I wasn't expecting '''i''', and hands up everyone who doesn't know the rafsi for '''vi'''.
*So it looks like the comment has morphed over the years. Nick, any recollection?
**Nope, although it sounds like the kind of thing I'd do. I remember it being dark, and I'm pretty sure that's all the Lojban I uttered...
